title: zerank-2: ZeroEntropy’s 4B reranker, weights and API | reranker.uk
description: zerank-2 review (Oct 2026): ZeroEntropy’s 4B reranker on Qwen3-4B, the licence conflict between its model card and docs, ZeroEntropy’s own scores against Cohere rerank-3.5, API pricing, and a sentence-transformers quick start.
og_description: Weights on Hugging Face and the same model as an API. Check the licence before self-hosting commercially: the model card and the docs disagree.
